body.justification: The ambient randomized calibration theorem yields an implementable exact-coverage procedure, while the atom calculation gives the matching limitation for deterministic strict and weak cutoffs.
body.gap: The resolved statement separates the positive vanishing-jitter construction from the narrower impossibility of exact deterministic single-threshold calibration at a straddling atom.
body.consumer: Practitioners obtain a covariance-adaptive Anderson--Rubin set that remains calibrated under singular and rank-changing influence covariance.
